description: The amplifier-foundation package was first implemented as the library for loading and composing bundles.
evidence: commit 2318bff: feat: implement amplifier-foundation package

description: PreparedBundle.spawn() was simplified to pure mechanism, and agent-name resolution was moved to the app layer as policy.
evidence: commit 3395171: feat: simplify spawn to mechanism-only, move policy to app layer

description: The design-intelligence behavior was included in the foundation bundle so design agents are available by default.
evidence: commit 55216c0: feat: include design-intelligence behavior in foundation bundle

description: The foundation bundle began including the lsp-python behavior for Python code intelligence via Pyright.
evidence: commit 70e314d: feat: add lsp-python bundle behavior include

description: The new hooks-todo-display module shipped with display mode 'auto', switching to condensed view for long lists.
evidence: commit dfc3247: feat: add hooks-todo-display module for visual todo list rendering

description: The session-finder agent was renamed session-analyst because its scope grew to debugging, safe log extraction and recovery.
evidence: commit 423cad8: Rename session-finder to session-analyst with expanded capabilities

description: The default todo display mode changed from 'auto' to 'full' so all items are always shown; auto-condensing became opt-in.
evidence: commit cb444ff: Change default todo display mode from 'auto' to 'full'

description: session-analyst gained rewind and repair guidance based on manually editing session files with backups.
evidence: commit 81c05d3: Add session rewind/repair capability to session-analyst agent

description: Spawned agents were configured to exclude tool-task so they do the work themselves instead of delegating further.
evidence: commit 41b29f3: Add spawn.exclude_tools to prevent agent delegation recursion

description: A spawn field was added to the Bundle dataclass to control which tools spawned agents inherit.
evidence: commit e7ca748: Add spawn field to Bundle for tool inheritance control

description: The spawn config moved out of Bundle into tool-task's own config, since tools own their configuration.
evidence: commit 8001076: Move spawn config from Bundle to tool-task config

description: git-ops, file-ops and web-research were promoted to default agents, the latter two as context sinks that keep large outputs out of the main session.
evidence: commit cdde830: feat: promote file-ops and web-research agents to defaults

description: The tool-skills module was added to the foundation bundle from its standalone module repository, giving users the load_skill tool.
evidence: commit 3a73a9b: feat: add tool-skills module to foundation bundle

description: Desktop notification support from amplifier-bundle-notify was included in the foundation bundle.
evidence: commit a37f04f: feat: add desktop notification support

description: Notification behaviors were removed from bundle defaults because they fired in every subprocess session; notifications became app-level policy.
evidence: commit 11678ab: fix: remove notification behaviors from bundle defaults

description: The shadow sandbox environment bundle was added to the amplifier-dev bundle for testing ecosystem changes.
evidence: commit 43cd6c5: feat: Add shadow bundle to amplifier-dev bundle

description: The lsp-python behavior was replaced by the full python-dev bundle in the foundation base, after dogfooding in amplifier-dev.
evidence: commit 98a70bf: feat: move python-dev bundle include to foundation base

description: Session naming was made synchronous because session:end fired before prompt:complete and background naming never finished.
evidence: commit ca1322b: fix: make session naming synchronous to fix event ordering issue

description: The shadow bundle moved from amplifier-dev into the foundation bundle, positioned as a general-purpose OS isolation tool for all foundation users.
evidence: commit 7c27fa2: feat: add shadow bundle to foundation (moved from amplifier-dev)

description: Circular and diamond dependency detection was reworked, and true circular dependencies were made to raise an error.
evidence: commit 093ec7d: fix: properly detect circular vs diamond dependencies in bundle loading (#34)

description: Graceful degradation was restored because hard errors on circular dependencies stopped the app and hid the real errors.
evidence: commit 7723fd6: fix: restore graceful degradation for circular dependencies (#35)

description: Session debug logging was turned on by default (debug: true in foundation, raw_debug in amplifier-dev).
evidence: commit d6fe690: feat: enable session debug logging by default

description: The MCP tool module was included by default because it is silent when unconfigured.
evidence: commit 37489ea: feat: include MCP tool module by default (#48)

description: The experimental delegate tool was promoted to production in foundation v2.0.0, replacing the legacy task tool (breaking change).
evidence: commit 0b08334: feat: promote experimental delegate tool to production v2.0.0

description: The experiments folder was deleted when the delegate tool was promoted, as no longer needed.
evidence: commit 0b08334: feat: promote experimental delegate tool to production v2.0.0

description: The experimental bundles were restored so users can compare experimental and production system prompts.
evidence: commit a2ba8a7: feat: restore experimental bundles for testing and comparison

description: Root context was cut from about 36K to about 11K tokens by moving philosophy docs into the specialist agents that need them.
evidence: commit 5560df0: refactor(context): apply context sink pattern - move philosophy docs to specialist agents

description: The delegate tool timeout was wired up with a default of None (disabled) instead of a dead 300s value.
evidence: commit 074bfab: fix: wire up delegate tool timeout config (default: None/disabled) (#73)

description: The foundation bundle switched its skills include to amplifier-bundle-skills, which wraps tool-skills and adds curated skills.
evidence: commit 3a14a6e: feat: update skills bundle and add browser-tester behavior

description: The superpowers bundle was included so all foundation users get its agents, modes and skills.
evidence: commit c8baee3: feat: add superpowers-methodology to foundation includes

description: exclude_tools was corrected to use the module name tool-delegate, because the wrong key let agents recurse 22 levels deep.
evidence: commit 274e831: fix(delegate): use module name in exclude_tools to actually exclude delegate tool

description: Class-based model routing (fast, balanced, powerful classes) was added to provider preferences.
evidence: commit fb13131: feat: add class-based model routing to provider preferences (#96)

description: Class-based model routing (PRs #96 to #100) was reverted the same day.
evidence: commit 4e1dd84: revert: remove class-based model routing (PRs #96-#100) (#101)

description: Agents gained model_role frontmatter, and foundation began including the routing-matrix bundle to resolve roles to models.
evidence: commit 517f94d: feat: add model_role frontmatter support and routing matrix integration (#102)

description: tool-delegate resolved model_role through the routing matrix integration.
evidence: commit 517f94d: feat: add model_role frontmatter support and routing matrix integration (#102)

description: The amplifier-core dependency was switched from git to PyPI for the Rust kernel.
evidence: commit b2d389f: feat: switch amplifier-core dependency from git to PyPI (Rust kernel)

description: Design research and generation behaviors were added to foundation defaults so all users get design agents.
evidence: commit 882c9d1: feat: Add design delegation guidance and include design research/generation behaviors

description: The design delegation change was reverted the same day.
evidence: commit ad0390c: Revert "feat: Add design delegation guidance and include design research/generation behaviors"

description: Delegate events were enriched with tool_call_id, parallel_group_id and session metadata (CP-4).
evidence: commit ffec33e: feat: delegate event enrichment and observability tooling (#117)

description: Bundle configs moved from debug/raw_debug to raw: true because providers now read 'raw' and the old flags emitted nothing.
evidence: commit 5da0056: fix: update provider/session configs from debug/raw_debug to raw

description: PR #119 rewrote overlapping parts of the delegate tool and accidentally removed the CP-4 enrichment code.
evidence: commit 73ee285: feat: Wire routing config through ProviderPreference to provider mount config (#119)

description: deep_merge now concatenates lists instead of replacing them, fixing silent config loss in bundle composition.
evidence: commit 70d521f: fix: concatenate lists in deep_merge instead of replacing — fixes silent config loss in bundle composition (#120)

description: The CP-4 delegate event enrichment was re-landed on top of PR #119.
evidence: commit f70646b: fix: re-land CP-4 delegate event enrichment (reverted by PR #119)

description: A subprocess-based Python gRPC adapter was added so non-Python hosts can use Python Amplifier modules.
evidence: commit d6cff12: feat: complete Python gRPC adapter implementation (v1)

description: Manual JSONL repair was removed from session-analyst; the Python repair script became the only path because manual edits made sessions worse.
evidence: commit 62fde35: docs(session-repair): enforce script-only repair workflow for session-analyst

description: Session naming became non-blocking with a session:end drain handler and model_role routing.
evidence: commit 1653695: feat(hooks-session-naming): non-blocking async + model_role routing (#144)

description: The tool-skills source was redirected from the deprecated standalone module to amplifier-bundle-skills.
evidence: commit f4d3252: fix: redirect tool-skills source from deprecated standalone to amplifier-bundle-skills

description: shadow-env was replaced ecosystem-wide by amplifier-tester and digital-twin-universe, and foundation swapped its include, agents, recipes and docs.
evidence: commit e10f999: feat: replace shadow-env with amplifier-tester / digital-twin-universe (#188)

description: The amplifier-smoke-test agent was deleted and replaced by amplifier-tester:validator.
evidence: commit e10f999: feat: replace shadow-env with amplifier-tester / digital-twin-universe (#188)

description: The routing_matrix session state was replaced by a duck-typed model_role_resolver capability so other routing strategies can plug in; backward compatibility was dropped.
evidence: commit 5c796c0: feat: rename routing_matrix capability → model_role_resolver (#197)

description: The routing_matrix capability was renamed model_role_resolver.
evidence: commit 5c796c0: feat: rename routing_matrix capability → model_role_resolver (#197)

description: amplifier-bundle-llm-wiki was included as a default-on behavior with near-zero cost when its modes are dormant.
evidence: commit 7eec50d: feat: include amplifier-bundle-llm-wiki as default-on behavior

description: amplifier-bundle-evaluation was included as a default-on behavior with zero ambient token cost.
evidence: commit 994a8af: feat: include amplifier-bundle-evaluation as default-on behavior

description: The token-streaming overlay was enabled by default (TTY-gated, opt-out).
evidence: commit 1257942: feat(streaming-ui): enable token-streaming overlay by default (TTY-gated, opt-out) (#241)

description: Default-on streaming was paused as temporary while delegate-session handling and interleaved assistant messages were finished.
evidence: commit ed4b5ca: feat(streaming-ui): disable token-streaming overlay by default (temporary) (#243)

description: Token streaming was re-enabled by default at the policy layer once sub-agent output curation and the double-render fix were done.
evidence: commit fc3afa7: feat(streaming-ui): enable token streaming by default (policy layer) (#245)

description: Agents got an Honest Stopping escape hatch to refuse and report instead of fabricating, after git-ops invented PR verification.
evidence: commit 19ba2c6: fix(agents): add Honest Stopping escape hatch so agents refuse-and-report instead of fabricating (#247)

description: Agent provider preferences now list claude-fable-* first and prompts were trimmed, since no earlier wildcard matched fable-5.
evidence: commit cac56b1: refactor: prompt-layer refresh for claude-fable-5
